---
title: Precision fixture
description: Source values carry more digits than any element shows, so the cross-style step can prove that every output shows the author's precision and no more (FEA-CH-37, DEL-52, DEL-80).
version: 0.0.1
slug: cross-style-precision
---

Every number below is written with more digits than it shows.

```metric
value: 1234567.891
label: Revenue in millions
format: number_compact
```

```metric
value: 167543.217
label: Visitors in thousands
format: number_compact
```

```metric
value: 0.123456789
label: Conversion as a percentage
format: percent
```

```metric
value: 98765.4321
label: Basket as currency
format: number
unit: "$"
```

```table
data:
  inline:
    - {item: Alpha, amount: 1234567.891, price: 98765.4321}
    - {item: Beta, amount: 167543.217, price: 4321.98765}
    - {item: Gamma, amount: 98.7654321, price: 12.3456789}
columns:
  - {key: item, label: Item}
  - {key: amount, label: Amount, format: number_compact, align: right}
  - {key: price, label: Price, format: number, unit: "$", align: right}
total: true
```

```table
data:
  inline:
    - {item: Alpha, rate: 0.123456789}
    - {item: Beta, rate: 0.045678912}
    - {item: Gamma, rate: 0.5}
columns:
  - {key: item, label: Item}
  - {key: rate, label: Rate, format: percent, align: right}
```

```table
data:
  inline:
    - {item: Alpha, level: 3.14159265}
    - {item: Beta, level: 2.71828183}
    - {item: Gamma, level: 1.41421356}
columns:
  - {key: item, label: Item}
  - {key: level, label: Level}
```

```chart
type: bar
title: Amounts keep three significant digits
data:
  inline:
    - {item: Alpha, amount: 1234567.891}
    - {item: Beta, amount: 167543.217}
    - {item: Gamma, amount: 98765.4321}
encoding: {x: item, y: amount}
axes:
  y: {label: Amount, format: number_compact}
```

```chart
type: bar
title: Rates as percentages
data:
  inline:
    - {item: Alpha, rate: 0.123456789}
    - {item: Beta, rate: 0.045678912}
    - {item: Gamma, rate: 0.5}
encoding: {x: item, y: rate}
axes:
  y: {label: Rate, format: percent}
```

```chart
type: line
title: Daily prices as currency
data:
  csv: data/prices.csv
encoding: {x: day, y: price}
axes:
  y: {label: Price, format: number, unit: "$"}
```

```chart
type: line
title: Plain decimals
data:
  inline:
    - {day: 2024-03-01, level: 3.14159265}
    - {day: 2024-03-02, level: 2.71828183}
    - {day: 2024-03-03, level: 1.41421356}
    - {day: 2024-03-04, level: 1.73205081}
encoding: {x: day, y: level}
axes:
  y: {label: Level}
```

```chart
type: pie
title: Shares
data:
  inline:
    - {part: North, share: 0.123456789}
    - {part: South, share: 0.234567891}
    - {part: East, share: 0.641975320}
encoding: {x: part, y: share}
```
